instructorNote: This is the escalation moment: discovery was 06:40, the public claim 07:15. The CISO should brief the cell on the 06:40 detection and the 07:05 suspension, keep the key suspended, send CartBridge a written notice with a request to preserve logs, and call the General Counsel now because an outside party claims to hold Tallis data. Watch whether LEGAL calls the CCO and CFO within the hour, sets up the Disclosure Committee within four hours, and logs 06:40 as the discovery time and 07:15 as the first public claim. Also watch whether anyone repeats the unvalidated "1.9M" or "cards" claims as fact.
